digest_scope: sorted UTF-8 project files keyed by POSIX relative path

route-navigation-deeplink-404.browser_reason: history and rendered route DOM are independently captured
route-navigation-deeplink-404.native_reason: eligible only when native navigation semantics are captured on a real runtime channel

component-template-view.browser_reason: rendered heading, text, visibility, and route attributes are captured
component-template-view.native_reason: eligible only when the rendered native component semantics are captured on a real runtime channel

state-management.browser_reason: framework state transition is rendered as raw attributes
state-management.native_reason: eligible only when native framework state before, after, and saturation are captured

action-event.browser_reason: native browser events and rendered handler outcome are captured
action-event.native_reason: eligible only when the native input event and handler outcome are captured

effect-lifecycle.browser_reason: the bounded browser driver does not remount and dispose the framework component per scenario
effect-lifecycle.native_reason: eligible only when ordered native mount, background, foreground, and dispose events are captured

form-binding-validation.browser_reason: live form control, browser ValidityState, error DOM, and active element are captured
form-binding-validation.native_reason: eligible only when native control value, validation, error semantics, and focus are captured

api-network.browser_reason: the bounded browser diagnostic does not yet prove timeout, retry, tenant cache, and unmount cancellation as one complete API contract
api-network.native_reason: a single native adapter call does not prove timeout, retry, tenant cache, and unmount cancellation

identity-permission.browser_reason: no real authority adapter is installed in the bounded local browser profile
identity-permission.native_reason: eligible only when a real native authority adapter decision trace is captured

rendering-hydration.browser_reason: the generated browser profiles are client rendered and expose no SSR hydration boundary
rendering-hydration.native_reason: eligible only when the applicable native rendering lifecycle and mutation surface is captured

accessibility-focus.browser_reason: accessibility tree, axe, focus, and keyboard events are captured by the browser driver
accessibility-focus.native_reason: eligible only when native accessibility semantics, focus, and input events are captured

i18n-theme-responsive.measurement_surface: html lang+rendered translated text+computed theme tokens+measured layout
i18n-theme-responsive.browser_reason: document language, rendered text, computed styles, and element geometry are captured
i18n-theme-responsive.native_reason: eligible only when native locale, rendered text, theme tokens, and measured layout are captured

native-platform.browser_reason: a browser channel cannot supply device identity or a native adapter trace
native-platform.native_reason: eligible only when real device semantics, lifecycle, permission, and adapter traces are captured
